name: u13
description: Workflow plugins for AI coding agents: a risk-based change review loop, lightweight project memory, and task planning.

plugins.name: review-loop
plugins.description: Preflight, implement, review, finish. Picks the depth automatically from the risk of the change. Works without git and without docs.

plugins.name: project-memory
plugins.description: Short, ID-numbered decisions, status and backlog kept in .u13/memory so any session can continue where the last one stopped.

plugins.name: task-planner
plugins.description: Clarify and split big tasks into subtasks with a plan file. Decisions are made by you (manual) or by a separate decider agent (delegate).
